name: random-v1
purpose: THE CONTROL that makes Claim A credible (Revision 4 arm II.7). Runs the full Prometheus machinery but scrambles the conditioning: it takes the base profile's per-tier BYTE TOTALS and randomly re-assigns which tensor groups land in which tier, holding the artifact's total bytes identical. This separates 'our capability conditioning works' (H2) from 'any non-uniform allocation works' (H1). Without this arm, the two are indistinguishable and only the first is a paper.
matched_bytes_invariant: The randomized allocation MUST reconcile to the same total physical bytes as the base profile. The pipeline asserts this; a mismatch is a bug, not a result.
protected_invariant: Structural tensors that must remain native (router, normalization, indexer) are pinned and never randomized into an excised tier. Randomizing the spine into oblivion would test nothing.
capability_gate_status: GATED: same evaluator dependency as the base profile.
